submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulation results across all three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) and five plate thicknesses (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 mm), Absorber-F2 with 6 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.228% at 100 GeV. This configuration outperforms the second-best option (Absorber-F1 at 4 mm with 3.731% resolution) by 0.503 percentage points, representing a significant improvement in detector performance. The F2 material shows optimal performance in the mid-thickness range, with resolution improving from 3.585% at 2 mm to the minimum of 3.228% at 6 mm, before degrading at larger thicknesses. This recommendation satisfies all project constraints: the material is from the approved candidate list, the 6 mm thickness falls within the required 2-10 mm range, and hands-on maintenance capability is preserved.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 6 mm achieves 3.228% resolution, which is the best among all 15 configurations tested (3 materials × 5 thicknesses). This outperforms F1 (best: 3.731% at 4 mm) and F3 (best: 5.161% at 4 mm).
